# A help desk for one to three people, with no per-agent fee.

> A shared support inbox you host yourself: email and contact-form tickets, saved replies with suggestions, first-reply targets and a customer portal. Open source, MIT, no per-agent fee. Try the triage in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
